item.title: COLUMN: Ranking the ‘groundhogs’ of Groundhog Day
item.description: Feb. 2 is almost over, and you may not have realized, but today was Groundhog Day. item.title: Eastern Illinois updates alert system following November armed person hoax
item.description: Eastern Illinois University announced in an email on Dec. 9, 2025, that it was updating its campus emergency alert procedures and offering campus training opportunities following the armed person hoax that happened in November. Vice President for Student Affairs Anne Flaherty said the biggest change to the emergency alert system is that text message notifications are now opt-out rather than opt-in. item.title: Charleston City Council passes resolutions to fund renovations
item.description: The Charleston City Council approved funding for resurfacing roads at its meeting on Tuesday.
